headline: Windsor Machines Q2FY27: Revenue up 34%, EBITDA falls
summary: Windsor Machines reported a 33.8% YoY revenue jump to ₹183 crore in Q2FY27, driven by Injection Moulding. However, EBITDA contracted sharply to ₹1.6 crore due to elevated costs.

headline: Kolte Patil cancels Q2FY27 post-results call
summary: Kolte Patil Developers will not host a conference call for Q2 and H1 FY27 results due to leadership transition and internal restructuring.

headline: R Systems Q3FY27: Adj. PAT up 53% YoY
summary: R Systems International reported a 53.1% YoY rise in adjusted net profit for Q3FY27, driven by 12.5% revenue growth in US$ terms and margin expansion to 20.2%.

headline: Bilcare Q2FY27: Net profit up 44% YoY
summary: Bilcare Ltd reported a 44% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹1.50 crore for Q2FY27. Revenue grew 4.3% YoY. Mohan Bhandari appointed Chairman.

headline: Clean Max Q2FY27: PAT jumps 82% YoY to ₹649 crore
summary: Clean Max Enviro Energy Solutions reported a 82% YoY rise in consolidated net profit for Q2FY27. Revenue from operations grew 37% YoY, driven by higher power sales.

headline: Servotech Q2 profit jumps to ₹94 million
summary: Servotech Renewable Power Systems reported a sharp rise in Q2 net profit to ₹94 million from ₹13 million, driven by 52% revenue growth.

headline: ARIS Q2 EBITDA jumps 58% to ₹356 million
summary: ARIS reported Q2 EBITDA of ₹356 million, up from ₹225 million YoY. Revenue rose to ₹3.08 billion, driving margin expansion to 11.57%.

headline: Transrail Q2 net profit rises to ₹1.05 billion
summary: Transrail reported a net profit of ₹1.05 billion for Q2, up from ₹918 million year-on-year. Revenue surged to ₹20.3 billion from ₹15.4 billion in the same period last year.

headline: KSB Q2 net profit falls to ₹572 million
summary: KSB Ltd reported a Q2 net profit of ₹572 million, down from ₹650 million YoY. Revenue rose to ₹7.73 billion, but EBITDA margin contracted to 10.59%.

headline: Endurance Q2 revenue jumps to 47.87B rupees YoY
summary: Endurance reported Q2 revenue of 47.87B rupees, up from 35.83B rupees in the same period a year ago, marking a significant year-on-year increase.

headline: IPL Q2 revenue falls to ₹2.26 billion
summary: India Pesticides Ltd reported Q2 revenue of ₹2.26 billion, down from ₹2.9 billion YoY. EBITDA margin contracted to 13.76% from 16.95%.

headline: Vijaya Q2 revenue rises to 2.55B rupees YoY
summary: Vijaya reported Q2 revenue of 2.55B rupees, up from 2.02B rupees in the same period last year, reflecting a year-on-year increase in topline performance.

headline: Speciality Q2 revenue rises 17% to ₹1.36 billion
summary: Speciality reported Q2 revenue of ₹1.36 billion, up from ₹1.16 billion YoY. EBITDA margin expanded to 18.40% as profits grew to ₹250 million.

headline: Ester Industries Q2 revenue rises to 4.4B rupees YoY
summary: Ester Industries posted Q2 revenue of 4.4B rupees, up from 3.54B rupees in the same period last year, reflecting a year-on-year improvement in topline performance.

headline: CleanMax Q2 revenue rises 37% YoY to 7.3B rupees
summary: CleanMax reported Q2 revenue of 7.3 billion rupees, up from 5.3 billion rupees in the same period last year, missing the analyst estimate of 7.41 billion rupees.

headline: Windsor Machines to decide on fund raising Nov 6
summary: Windsor Machines Ltd board meeting scheduled for November 6, 2026, to consider fund raising via preferential issue, QIP, or rights issue.

headline: Sedemac hits 5 million scooter controller sales
summary: Sedemac Mechatronics achieved cumulative sales of over 5 million motor controllers for scooters in October 2026, marking a key milestone for its EV and ISG ECU products.

headline: Power Grid appoints Anupam Kumar as Govt Nominee Director
summary: Power Grid Corporation of India appoints Anupam Kumar as Government Nominee Director effective November 3, 2026. Abhay Bakre ceases role on same date.

headline: Ruparel Food pays BSE fine for late annual report
summary: Ruparel Food Products Limited paid a ₹2,360 fine to BSE for delayed submission of its FY26 annual report under Regulation 34. The company completed filing on October 30, 2026.

headline: Corona Remedies gets ₹4.88 Cr NPPA notice
summary: Corona Remedies received a demand notice of ₹4.88 crore from NPPA for alleged DPCO 2013 violations. The company states the impact on financials is not material.

headline: Cholamandalam RTA shifts office Dec 2026
summary: Cholamandalam Investment and Finance Company Limited announced that its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent, KFin Technologies, will relocate its corporate office effective December 1, 2026.

headline: Ion Exchange chairman Rajesh Sharma to step down
summary: Ion Exchange (India) Ltd approved the change in designation of Rajesh Sharma from Executive Chairman to Non-Executive Non-Independent Chairman effective January 1, 2027.

headline: MPS Q2FY27 Results: EBITDA up 27%
summary: MPS Limited reported a 15.35% YoY rise in revenue to ₹224.29 crore for Q2FY27. EBITDA surged 27.39% YoY, hitting a record margin of 34.34%.

headline: SignatureGlobal buys 1.10 acre land in Gurugram
summary: SignatureGlobal India Ltd executed a sale deed for 1.1014 acres in Gurugram on November 3, 2026. The parcel offers 0.1 million sq ft developable area, part of a larger 4.26-acre collaboration.

headline: Bharti Airtel issues final call reminder
summary: Bharti Airtel Limited has issued a second reminder notice for the payment of the First and Final Call on 649,835 partly paid-up equity shares. The deadline for payment is November 19, 2026.

headline: JG Chemicals appoints two independent directors
summary: JG Chemicals appoints Sunil Duggal and Kaushik Roy as Independent Directors to strengthen governance. Both bring decades of experience in metals, mining, and chemicals sectors.

headline: SBI Life seeks member approval for new independent director
summary: SBI Life Insurance Company Limited has issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for the appointment of Nihar Niranjan Jambusaria as an Independent Director.

headline: Parag Milk Foods Q2FY27 PAT falls 12% YoY
summary: Parag Milk Foods reported a 11.5% YoY decline in consolidated net profit for Q2FY27, despite 23% revenue growth. The board also approved the amalgamation of Bhagyalaxmi Dairy Farms.

headline: Allcargo Q2FY27: EBITDA jumps 24% to ₹77 crore
summary: Allcargo Logistics reports strong Q2FY27 results with EBITDA rising 24.2% YoY to ₹77 crore. Revenue grew 3.4% to ₹555 crore, driven by margin expansion in Express and Contract Logistics.

headline: Diligent Media Q2FY27: Profit turns positive, auditor flags issues
summary: Diligent Media Corporation posted a net profit of ₹14.13 lakh in Q2FY27, reversing a loss. However, auditors issued a qualified opinion due to unresolved inter-corporate deposit disputes and going concern doubts.

headline: Fractal Analytics Q2FY27 profit jumps 139% YoY
summary: Fractal Analytics reported a 139% YoY rise in consolidated PAT to ₹792 million. Revenue grew 20% to ₹9,565 million. Board approved winding up of Analytics Vidhya Inc.

headline: Vijaya Diagnostic appoints Rahul Jain as CS
summary: Vijaya Diagnostic Centre appoints Rahul Jain as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective November 3, 2026. The appointment follows Board approval under SEBI regulations.

headline: Roadstar Infra secures ₹2,753 crore loan for refinancing
summary: Roadstar Infra Investment Trust availed a secured Rupee Term Loan of up to ₹2,753 crore from Union Bank of India and IIFCL to refinance existing SPV borrowings.

headline: NSE performs Bhoomi Pujan for new BKC office
summary: NSE performed Bhoomi Pujan for its new office building in Bandra Kurla Complex, Mumbai. The 10,995 sq metre plot is on an 80-year lease from MMRDA.

headline: Diligent Media board approves director re-appointment, SMP elevations
summary: Diligent Media Corporation Ltd board meeting on November 3, 2026, approved Nagendra Bhandari's re-appointment and elevated three senior management personnel.

headline: Robokidz Q2FY27 PAT up 395% YoY to ₹685 lakh
summary: Robokidz Eduventures reported a 395% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹685.42 lakh for H1FY27. Revenue from operations surged 186% YoY to ₹5,219.05 lakh.

headline: Ion Exchange posts Q2 net loss of ₹810M
summary: Ion Exchange reported a consolidated net loss of ₹810 million in Q2, compared to a profit of ₹495.3 million last year. Revenue declined to ₹6.74 billion.

headline: Lupin Q2FY27: Consolidated PAT dips to ₹11,553 mn
summary: Lupin Limited reported a 22% YoY decline in consolidated net profit for Q2FY27. Revenue rose 11% YoY, driven by strong pharmaceutical sales growth.

headline: Lupin appoints Akhil Gupta as independent director
summary: Lupin Limited appointed Akhil Gupta as an Additional Director (Non-Executive, Independent) effective November 3, 2026. He brings over four decades of experience in corporate strategy and finance.

headline: Belding India Q2FY27: Loss widens, merger on hold
summary: Belding India Limited reported a consolidated net loss of ₹555.15 lakh for Q2FY27, widening from ₹13.16 lakh in Q2FY26. The board also kept the DC&T Global merger scheme in abeyance.
